tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Paper by day, Night by night.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Raised layer: Card on paper, Graphite on night (sidebars). Separated from ground by a ground shift and a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Recessed track behind a segmented control or stepper, a step below the ground. The selected segment sits on raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and numerals. 16.6:1 on paper, 15.7:1 on night.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, units beside a numeral, inactive segments. 8.4:1 on paper, 8.9:1 on night.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Mono labels and metadata (Stone on paper, Ash on night). 4.5:1 and 5.5:1: small caps labels only, never body text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between rows, blocks and panels. Full rules divide; partial edges never highlight.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: 1px outline of a control: pills, secondary buttons, steppers, the edges of a window.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Idle marks: empty rating dots, unfilled progress ticks.

tokens.name: nominal
tokens.usage: Kelp. Break's instrument accent: chart line, live dot, the status dot on the mark, and 'good' on Break's verdicts. Text, 1px lines and dots only. 5.5:1 on paper, 7.9:1 on night.

tokens.name: nominal-selection
tokens.usage: Selected row or cell ground in Break. Never an edge highlight.

tokens.name: nominal-chart-fill
tokens.usage: Peak of the chart fade under a nominal line. Fades to nothing at the baseline.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Olive phosphor, after a P1 scope trace. Trace's instrument accent: chart line, sparklines, live dot, progress ticks, and 'good' on Trace's verdicts. 5.4:1 on paper, 9.7:1 on night.

tokens.name: phosphor-selection
tokens.usage: Selected row or nav item ground in Trace. Never an edge highlight.

tokens.name: phosphor-chart-fill
tokens.usage: Peak of the chart fade under a phosphor line.

tokens.name: scratch-accent
tokens.usage: Cyanotype. Scratch's accent: links, cursor, current state. 7.0:1 on paper, 8.1:1 on night.

tokens.name: scratch-selection
tokens.usage: Selected note or row ground in Scratch. Never an edge highlight.

tokens.name: scratch-chart-fill
tokens.usage: Peak of the chart fade under a cyanotype line.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Ground of a marked span: Break's best window, Trace's test interval, a found match in Scratch. Always bounded by a rule-strong hairline at each edge; labels sit outside it.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Verdict 'fair' in every instrument. 5.6:1 on paper, 6.5:1 on night.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Verdict 'poor', the Stop ring, and the only signal for a destructive action (clay text, never a red panel). 4.9:1 on paper, 6.4:1 on night.

tokens.name: survey
tokens.usage: Studio accent. Studio surfaces only (site, guide), never inside an app. 7.6:1 on paper, 8.8:1 on night.

tokens.name: survey-wash
tokens.usage: Text selection on studio surfaces only.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: Secondary reading; unit beside it at 16px in ink-soft.

styles.name: numeral-mono
styles.usage: Trace's readings. Plex Mono 300, never Courier.

styles.name: mark
styles.usage: Wordmarks only: Break, Trace, Scratch, Scratch Studios. Cutive Mono caps, tracked. Never in UI chrome.

styles.name: place
styles.usage: Place names and pills: Barlow Medium caps.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Download is 21% lower than your reference.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Changes apply immediately. There is no Save button.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Untouched scratches move out of your way

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap between a numeral and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, tight.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, default; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks, roomy.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections, roomy.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, rows, cells, charts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Desktop controls: segmented controls, steppers, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Pills, dots and ring buttons.
